plans.name: Essential
plans.description: Messenger live chat, shared inbox and ticketing, pre-built reports, public help center, basic automation. Fin AI Agent is $0.99 per outcome.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.description: Everything in Essential plus workflow automation builder, multiple team inboxes, round robin assignment, private and multilingual help center, and 20 free Lite seats.

plans.name: Expert
plans.description: Everything in Advanced plus SSO and identity management, HIPAA support, SLAs, multibrand Messenger and help center, and 50 free Lite seats.

plans.name: Fin AI Agent (add-on)
plans.description: Charged once per resolved conversation at most; no charge if Fin cannot answer or the customer asks for a human. Works on all plans or on top of an existing helpdesk via sales.

plans.name: Support Team
plans.description: Email and ticketing, ticket routing, prebuilt analytics dashboards, pre-written responses, customer context, automations and triggers.

plans.name: Suite Team
plans.description: Support Team features plus AI agents, AI knowledge base, AI action builder, omnichannel routing, messaging and live chat, and telephony.

plans.name: Suite Professional
plans.description: Suite Team features plus AI admin copilot, AI app builder, AI writing tools, AI quick reports, skills-based routing and an IVR phone tree.

plans.name: Suite Enterprise + Copilot
plans.description: Suite Professional features plus intelligent triage, auto assist, generative AI for voice, approval workflows, a sandbox environment and custom agent roles.

plans.name: Free
plans.description: Limited chat and agent usage; CLI and agent mode supported.

plans.name: Pro
plans.description: $10 base credits plus a $5 flex allotment each month; adds pull request reviews, assigning work to Copilot and the cloud agent.

plans.name: Pro+
plans.description: $39 base credits plus a $31 flex allotment each month.

plans.name: Max
plans.description: $100 base credits plus a $100 flex allotment each month.

plans.name: Starter
plans.description: At up to 10k monthly pageviews; price rises with traffic. One site, 3 years of data retention, email/Slack reports, Google Analytics import, goals and custom events.

plans.name: Growth
plans.description: At up to 10k monthly pageviews. Everything in Starter plus up to 3 sites, up to 3 team members, team management, shared links and embedded dashboards.

plans.name: Business
plans.description: At up to 10k monthly pageviews. Everything in Growth plus up to 10 sites and team members, 5 years of retention, Stats API, funnels and ecommerce revenue attribution.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.description: 10+ sites and team members, SSO, managed proxy, scheduled raw event exports and priority support.
